<!-- uv-active-slice: execution-plan-retirement -->
<!-- uv-next-slice: execution-plan-retirement -->

## Goal

Execute the bounded D-070 `execution-plan-retirement` slice: retire the isolated legacy recipe-derived execution-plan client/API/projection without creating a replacement planner and without prematurely retiring Product Orchestrator, internal Recipe Registry, Stage8 or persisted-project compatibility.

## Changes

- removed execution-plan types and `getProjectExecutionPlan()` from `frontend/lib/projectsApi.ts`;
- deleted `uv_studio/api/execution.py` and removed `execution_router` from `uv_studio/server.py`;
- deleted `uv_studio/recipes/execution.py` and removed its projection exports;
- removed projection-only unit/API tests that had no authority after the projection was deleted;
- added `tests/test_execution_plan_retirement.py` to prove the retired files/client/server mount stay absent while internal Recipe Registry, Product Workflow and Studio router mounts remain;
- synchronized `CURRENT_ARCHITECTURE.md`, `UV_STUDIO_V2_ARCHITECTURE_MAP.md`, `LEGACY_SURFACE_INVENTORY.md` and project context.

## Caller proof

The modern project page already uses `getProjectWorkflow()` plus project/Studio Timeline APIs; no supported UI caller of `getProjectExecutionPlan()` required migration. Product Orchestrator `/workflow` depends on internal Recipe Registry directly and does not depend on the deleted recipe execution projection.

GitHub Code Search returned incomplete/empty results for known exact-head symbols, so zero search results are not treated as absence proof. The retirement proof is exact-head file/caller inspection, focused regression tests, permanent CI and the repository-required fresh independent semantic review.

No replacement Recipe-like readiness planner is introduced. Modern readiness remains owned by the relevant Production / Generation / Capability authorities when required; legacy `/workflow` remains a separately scheduled compatibility surface.

## Verification

Lifecycle-closed BASE is `af9ff888145661381caaacdec78244637058bce2`.

Final material Draft head `f7e0c1929de2da3f4cdd300b62cb232c669a38c9` passed CI #4839 with all five permanent checks SUCCESS, including unit/API integration, Stage4A real-media, frontend lint/audit/build and Stage4C+Stage5 browser outcomes on Ubuntu and Windows.

Current review HEAD is `01095095fbdabfdbf840063f10e968ad0c305d14`. The delta from the green material head is context-only lifecycle refreeze (`draft -> review`); runtime/frontend/tests/product behavior are unchanged.

This exact review head must pass all five permanent checks and receive the repository-required fresh ordinary-ChatGPT semantic review under `.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` v1.0 before merge.

## Architecture impact

The removed execution-plan surface was legacy recipe composition with no supported modern UI caller. Product Workflow, internal Recipe Registry, Production Directions, Studio creation, canonical Project/Timeline/Generation/Capability authorities and persisted-project compatibility remain intact.

## Known limitations

This slice does not retire Product Orchestrator, broadly migrate the legacy `/projects/{id}` workspace, retire Stage8 runtime/compatibility, redesign Production Directions, change Agent autonomy or alter Timeline identity.

## Next task

Exact review-head 5/5 CI -> fresh ordinary-ChatGPT semantic review on exact BASE/HEAD -> validate findings -> merge exact reviewed HEAD -> mandatory D-038 closure to `idle` before the next bounded D-070 migration slice.
